ai-workforce.hook: A customer asks the gold rate on WhatsApp at 10 at night.
ai-workforce.does: Your AI agent answers from a knowledge base you fill with your products, policies and store details.
ai-workforce.changes: Late night enquiries get a reply instead of going cold.

ai-workforce.hook: You worry an AI might promise a discount you never approved.
ai-workforce.does: You set the limits: what the agent may do alone and what it must send to you for approval.
ai-workforce.changes: The AI works on its own, inside the limits you set.

ai-workforce.hook: You want to check what the bot told a customer yesterday.
ai-workforce.does: Every agent reply and action is kept in activity and run logs you can review.
ai-workforce.changes: Nothing the AI says is hidden from you.

ai-workforce.hook: A website visitor asks about bridal sets while staff are busy.
ai-workforce.does: The website chat widget answers visitors with AI and the conversation lands in your shared inbox.
ai-workforce.changes: Website visitors are answered and become contacts you can follow up.

customer-memory.hook: You forget a loyal customer's wedding anniversary.
customer-memory.does: An Upcoming Occasions page lists customers' birthdays and anniversaries so staff can wish them each day.
customer-memory.changes: Every important date becomes a reason to reach out.

customer-memory.hook: A walk-in liked a necklace, left, and nobody called back.
customer-memory.does: Leads sit on a pipeline board by stage so every enquiry has an owner and a next step.
customer-memory.changes: Enquiries are followed up instead of forgotten.

customer-memory.hook: A regular walks in and the new salesman doesn't know her.
customer-memory.does: One customer record shows family links, payments, store visits and scheme status together.
customer-memory.changes: Any staff member can serve any customer like a regular.

customer-memory.hook: You have no idea which customers have stopped buying.
customer-memory.does: Reports group customers by how recently, how often and how much they buy, and by where they are in the funnel.
customer-memory.changes: You know exactly who to win back.

pricing-engine.hook: Gold moves overnight and every price tag is now wrong.
pricing-engine.does: Formula pricing recalculates each product from the live metal rate, weight, making charges and stones.
pricing-engine.changes: Prices follow the gold rate without manual repricing.

pricing-engine.hook: A customer wants a price for a custom bridal set in 22K.
pricing-engine.does: Build a quote from your products, adjust purity per line, priced at the metal rate.
pricing-engine.changes: Accurate quotes in minutes, not by calculator.

pricing-engine.hook: Gold rises and the customer insists on last week's quoted price.
pricing-engine.does: Quotes carry an expiry date and a rate lock you set.
pricing-engine.changes: Your quoted price has clear terms.

pricing-engine.hook: Billing a 22K chain takes ages of rate and weight calculations.
pricing-engine.does: Scan the tag and the bill fills with the piece, priced at today's metal rate shown on screen.
pricing-engine.changes: Fast, correct bills at the live rate.

integrations.hook: Your accountant keeps the books in Tally and won't switch.
integrations.does: Jwero connects to Tally and Zoho Books, maps your ledgers, imports masters and checks records against Tally.
integrations.changes: Your accountant keeps Tally; you stop entering the same bill twice.

integrations.hook: Google Shopping and Instagram show last week's prices.
integrations.does: Sync your catalogue to Google Shopping and the Meta catalogue; prices follow today's rate.
integrations.changes: Marketplace orders land with your other orders.

integrations.hook: Your Shopify store shows pieces you sold in the shop yesterday.
integrations.does: Connect Shopify or WooCommerce so your online store works from the same product data.
integrations.changes: Online and shop stock stop telling different stories.

integrations.hook: Listing the same product on every channel takes all afternoon.
integrations.does: Publish products from your product list to Meta catalogue, WhatsApp and other channels in one step.

platform.hook: Your bills, stock and gold rate are in three different places.
platform.does: One system holds live metal-rate pricing, stock, billing and accounts on the same data.
platform.changes: One version of the truth for the whole shop.
